text: BAM’s share rose 1.38 percentage points over 24 hours and 1.16 percentage points over 7 days to 35.8%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 25.3% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 66 top-node leadership changes in this window are best read as whale-driven routing, not validator churn or another structural rollover.
